description: Details of one fishing water (revír), river/lake (tok) or river basin (povodie): code, water type, river, region and district, SRZ organisation, length, coordinates, key properties and page URL. Pass the numeric id from search_site/waters_near results, or the page url.

id.description: Page id of the water, as returned in the id field of other tools.

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

url.description: Alternatively, the full page URL of the water on this site.

name: get_water
title: Get fishing water details
